events.description: A set of point sources (dots) is initialized on screen, and a blue wave slice background appears, showing concentric circular wave patterns radiating from the sources.
events.clip_query: concentric blue wave patterns radiating from point sources

events.description: The point sources are animated to move closer together or further apart, causing the interference fringes and wave superposition patterns to dynamically shift and update in real-time.
events.clip_query: shifting wave interference patterns from moving point sources

events.description: The wave visualization transitions to show intensity (squared amplitude) instead of raw amplitude, or parameters like frequency/wave number are adjusted, altering the fringe spacing.
events.clip_query: wave intensity interference fringes with high contrast
